vulnerabilities.title: Missing CSRF Protection
vulnerabilities.remediation: Use csurf or lusca middleware for CSRF protection when sessions are enabled.

vulnerabilities.remediation: Use environment variables or a configuration management system for sensitive values.

vulnerabilities.title: Insecure Random Number Generator
vulnerabilities.codeSnippet:
"description": "Grant privacy in public to watch your favorite programs",
      "price": parseInt(Math.random() * 100),
      "image": "product_1.jpg"
vulnerabilities.remediation: Use crypto.randomBytes() or crypto.randomUUID() for security-sensitive operations.

vulnerabilities.title: Regular Expression Denial of Service (ReDoS)
vulnerabilities.remediation: Simplify the regex pattern to avoid catastrophic backtracking. Use re2 for untrusted input.

vulnerabilities.title: Open Redirect
vulnerabilities.remediation: Validate redirect URLs against a whitelist of allowed destinations. Use relative paths where possible.

vulnerabilities.title: Prototype Pollution
vulnerabilities.remediation: Freeze Object.prototype. Use Object.create(null) for dictionary objects. Validate property names against __proto__ and constructor.
